description: This file defines the 'Information' model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for retrieving information records, associated descriptions, layout IDs, and cache management from the database.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Model class for handling information records, descriptions, layouts, and caching within the catalog context of Opencart.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a detailed information record from the database based on the provided information ID, including descriptions filtered by language and store, only if active.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches all active information records, utilizing caching to optimize repeated retrievals, ordered by sort order and title.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout ID associated with a specific information ID; returns 0 if none found.
